howTitle: How to copy and paste between devices
steps: Type or paste your text into the box and choose how long it should be kept.
Click “Save to clipboard” to get a 6-digit code, a short link and a QR code.
On your other device, open this website and enter the code — or simply scan the QR code.
Copy the text or download it as a .txt file. It disappears automatically when it expires.
aboutText: A clipboard is the temporary memory your computer or phone uses when you copy and paste. It only works on a single device. An online clipboard does the same job over the internet, so you can copy text on your laptop and paste it on your phone, a work computer, a friend’s tablet or a smart TV.

WebClipboard is perfect for moving links, notes, addresses, code snippets, Wi-Fi details or any other text without emailing yourself or installing an app. It is fast, free and works in every language.

faq.a: Yes. WebClipboard is completely free and supported by advertising. There are no limits on how many clips you can create.

faq.q: How long is my text stored?
faq.a: You decide: 10 minutes, 1 hour, 1 day or 7 days. After that the text is permanently deleted. With “Delete after the first view” it is removed as soon as it is opened.

faq.q: Is it safe to share private information?
faq.a: Anyone with the 6-digit code can open a clip, so do not share passwords or bank details without protection. If you set a password, the text is encrypted in your browser and nobody — not even us — can read it without the password.

faq.q: Do I need to install an app?
faq.a: No. WebClipboard runs in any web browser. You can also add it to your home screen for one-tap access.

faq.q: How much text can I save?
faq.a: Up to {max} characters per clip — enough for long documents, code or lists.

faq.q: I lost my code. Can I recover my text?
faq.a: No. We do not keep accounts or logs that could link a clip to you, so a lost code cannot be recovered. Simply create a new clip.
